correctness.rationale: Derivation from U=M^8=I+3B, restricted analytic A_r(t), five unit-derivative branches, three exceptional F polynomials modulo 3, two Hensel critical points, and restricted analytic square normalization gives each exact fibre count. Scientific limitations: finite checks are not the infinite proof and no independent audit has occurred.

originality.rationale: The five regular 3-adic branches, least periods, surjectivity, and minimum fibres are prior results, not new. The new all-target formula resolves the three outstanding index branches through two distinct quadratic critical values and a third three-disc isometric branch. Neither the inspected valuation papers, cycle paper, nor closely indexed recurrence-fibre records covers those exact contributions. Unindexed or implicit equivalent statements remain possible.
residual_risks: Unindexed literature may derive equivalent all-target recurrence pushforward measures under a different normalization.
A general p-adic analytic recurrence theorem may implicitly subsume the singular normal forms, though no decisive such source was identified in inspected comparisons.
The 3-adic analytic Morse and coefficient bounds warrant independent verification; they are explicitly proved in RESULT.md and not assumed by source inspection.
